items.finding: **fix** `electron/project-document-media.ts:48`: `sync()` embeds every file in the cache directory (`files()`), not only the paths that records reference (`documentMediaPaths`). Some commands drop rows without unlinking files (`delete_version` in `electron/commands/image-versions.ts:260`, and the `delete_shot` cascades). Failure: a user deletes an unwanted take, then shares or Save As copies the `.showbiz`. The deleted image is still inside the file, and the file grows without bound. Legacy conversion already copies only referenced paths (`project-document-copy.ts:55`), so the two disagree. Fix: sync from `documentMediaPaths(db)`, or prune unreferenced files first.
items.resolution: Package sync embeds only record-referenced media; deleted/unreferenced cache data is excluded.

items.finding: **fix** `electron/project-documents.ts:177`, `:318`, `:361`: `create`, `saveAs` and `importLegacy` open the target with `"wx"`, but the native `showSaveDialog` has already asked "Replace existing file?". Failure: the user confirms Replace and gets a raw `EEXIST: file already exists, open '...'` banner. Catch EEXIST with a clear message, or replace safely through a temp file and rename.
items.resolution: Confirmed replacement publishes through temporary/backup files with guarded rollback.

items.finding: **note** `electron/project-documents.ts:96-104`: each open extracts all media into `project-cache/open-XXXX`, which is removed only on dispose. After a crash, a full duplicate of the project's media stays forever, once per crash. Sweep it at startup, skipping directories with a live lock owner.
items.resolution: Project cache startup sweep identifies live owners and removes abandoned extraction workspaces.

items.finding: **note** `electron/project-document-lock.ts:11-22`: stale-lock detection is only `process.kill(pid, 0)`. After a reboot, a reused PID blocks opening with "already open in Showbiz", and nothing points at `X.showbiz.lock`. Because the lock sits next to the document, read-only locations cannot be opened.
items.resolution: Lock ownership includes process identity to reject PID reuse; read-only document inspection no longer requires a writable adjacent lock.

items.finding: **note** `electron/project-documents.ts:176` vs `:206`: `create`/`saveAs` store `path.resolve(file)`, but `open` compares `fs.realpathSync(file)`. A document under a symlinked directory, reopened from Recent, misses the "already active" shortcut and then collides with its own lock.
items.resolution: Create/Open/Save As share canonical real-file identity through symlinked directories.

items.finding: **note** `electron/main.ts:61`: `will-quit` does `void projects.dispose()` and ignores the result, so a failed final persist is lost without a trace. At least log it.

items.resolution: docs/project-documents.md:36 explicitly records synchronous main-thread embedding and rollback extraction as a large-project limitation.

items.finding: **fix** `electron/commands/generation-usage.ts:26-34`: the "running becomes interrupted" sweep runs inside `createGenerationUsageCommands`, which runs on every `bind`. That includes `saveAs` (`electron/project-documents.ts:321-324`: `VACUUM INTO`, then `prepare`). Failure: Save As while a video generation is in flight marks that request `interrupted`.
